sample_unit: participants with moderate to severe atopic dermatitis (planned)
models_evaluated: AI assistant decision-making system (AIADMS) app with deep learning model for AD diagnosis and severity grading
unlisted_practices: App-supported treat-to-target follow-up at scheduled time points with patient self-evaluation to improve treatment adherence

screen.reason: This is a study protocol for a randomized controlled trial evaluating the clinical efficacy of an AI-assisted decision-making mobile app versus routine care for atopic dermatitis management.
